topic: ES dirbtinio intelekto akto 50 straipsnis — kada verslas turi žymėti DI sukurtą turinį
summary: Golden regression article: transparency obligations of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (AI Act), Article 50.
questions: Nuo kada reikia žymėti DI sukurtą turinį?
Ar reikia žymėti DI parašytus reklamos tekstus?
Kokia bauda gresia už nepažymėtą DI turinį?

claims.claim: The transparency obligations of Article 50 of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (AI Act) apply from 2 August 2026
Providers must ensure that AI systems intended to interact directly with natural persons inform them that they are interacting with an AI system, unless this is obvious (Art. 50(1))

Providers of AI systems generating synthetic audio, image, video or text must ensure the outputs are marked in a machine-readable format and detectable as artificially generated or manipulated (Art. 50(2))

Deployers of an AI system that generates or manipulates image, audio or video content constituting a deep fake must disclose that the content has been artificially generated or manipulated; for evidently artistic, creative, satirical or fictional works the obligation is limited to disclosure in a way that does not hamper the display or enjoyment of the work (Art. 50(4))

Deployers of an AI system that generates or manipulates text published to inform the public on matters of public interest must disclose that the text was artificially generated or manipulated, unless it underwent human review or editorial control and a natural or legal person holds editorial responsibility (Art. 50(4))
Non-compliance with Article 50 is subject to administrative fines of up to EUR 15 000 000 or up to 3 % of total worldwide annual turnover, whichever is higher (Art. 99(4))
For SMEs, including start-ups, each fine is up to the percentage or amount, whichever is lower (Art. 99(6))
The information must be given in a clear and distinguishable manner at the latest at the time of the first interaction or exposure (Art. 50(5))
The AI Office encourages and facilitates codes of practice on the detection and labelling of artificially generated or manipulated content (Art. 50(7))

A provider develops an AI system (or has it developed) and places it on the market or puts it into service under its own name; a deployer uses an AI system under its authority, except for personal non-professional activity (Art. 3(3), 3(4))

A deep fake is AI-generated or manipulated image, audio or video content that resembles existing persons, objects, places, entities or events and would falsely appear to a person to be authentic or truthful (Art. 3(60))
